I’ve always been fascinated by how technology can solve real-world problems, especially in industries where data-driven decisions shape the future. At NexGen Technologies, I focus on building scalable machine learning solutions that empower enterprises to unlock value from their data. My work bridges cutting-edge research with practical applications, whether it’s refining natural language models for customer support or optimizing computer vision systems for industrial automation.  

Over the past three years, I’ve contributed to projects that range from designing robust ETL pipelines on Snowflake to deploying production-grade models using MLflow. A recent highlight was leading a team to integrate large language models into a customer service platform, which reduced response latency by 40% and improved user satisfaction. I also enjoy experimenting with prompt engineering to fine-tune models for specific use cases, ensuring they align with business goals.  

I’m always looking for opportunities to collaborate on projects that push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI. Whether it’s refining workflows with Apache Airflow, exploring new applications for MLOps, or diving deeper into NLP challenges, I’m driven by the potential to create meaningful impact. Let’s build something that matters.
